reviews.comment: Professor Yu was so engaging! Although he has a thick accent (tolerable), he is the first math professor I've had that was so engaged in his materials, and really created a collaborative environment. I loved his positivity and the course itself is not hard. A few quizzes, short homework assignments, and EASY exams. I would 10/10 take him again.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Class was very difficult and hard to understand him most of the time. I struggled a lot in math 167

He's pretty good. Expectations for students were moderate, and the course material wasn't very complex, nor were the exams. While lectures may be hard to understand (he tries his best), the provided blank notes transferred EXACTLY (topic-for-topic) to the homework and exams. Lenient test writing. Highly accessible in and out of class. Pretty good!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class I really struggled in. I had to teach myself a lot of the concepts. But the professor was accessible outside of class he just was hard to understand at times.
